question: The population of a village decreases every year at the rate of 3%. If the present population is 28227, what was the population of the village two years ago?
solution:
Given:

village's current population = 28227

Rate of decrease of population = R = 3%

Time = 2 years

Formula used:

If total current population is x, rate of decrease of population is R and time is T then

T year ego population = x × {(100/100 - R)}T

Calculation:

Population of the town 2 years ago = 28227 × (100/97)2

⇒ 28227 × 100/97 × 100/97 =

⇒ 30000

∴ The population of the town 2 years ago was 30000.
